context:
Goal: the right licence tier, with no surprise if a vendor audits.
Problem (money): free tiers end at a revenue line: Unity Personal at $200K of revenue plus funding, Fab (the Unreal asset store) Personal at $100K, and Unreal charges for non-game seats above $1M. Which tier applies depends on who buys.
Based on (read): Unity's pricing page and Fab's licence page, read by the 3D tools survey lane.
Departs from: main — adds who owns 3D licences.

Not blocking, and it matters only if you pick Unity or Unreal on item 130.

options.gain: The right tier for company work.
options.how: Company work uses a company licence.
options.label: Your employer buys, for work done for them
options.lose: Needs purchase approval; Unity Pro is $2,310 per seat a year.

options.label: You buy personally
options.lose: Free tiers are the wrong tier for company work.

title: If you use a paid 3D tool, who buys the licence?
why: Right when the work is for your employer; pick b only for personal projects.
